item.title: Crowdstrike by APR closes on Asian Le Mans Series title with 1-2 in Abu Dhabi
item.description: The No. 4 Crowdstrike Racing by APR ORECA-Gibson team made it three wins in a row in the Asian Le Mans Series at the opening race of the season finale doubleheader in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Formula E confirms Evo Sessions line-up and event format
item.description: The full line-up and format for Formula E’s Evo Sessions influencer event has been revealed, with two teams of the internet’s most followed personalities set to go head-to-head at the Jeddah Corniche Circuit after next week’s Jeddah E-Prix.

item.title: Bird enjoying Formula E sabbatical but still wants back in a car
item.description: One of the series’ most experienced and successful drivers was left on the sidelines following the departure of McLaren.

item.title: DKR wins Abu Dhabi finale as Crowdstrike by APR claims Asian Le Mans Series title
item.description: The No. 3 DKR Engineering ORECA won the sixth and final race of the 2025-26 Asian Le Mans Series season in Abu Dhabi, with Alexander Mattschull, Mathias Beche and Griffin Peebles standing on the top step of the podium. Peebles crossed the line over 11 seconds ahead of the rest...

item.title: Citroen making its mark fast in Formula E
item.description: The French manufacturer's move into Formula E was a curious one considering its lack of previous open-wheel history, but it's proven a quick study.

item.title: NASCAR bans drivers from using hands to redirect air during qualifying
item.description: A NASCAR Rule Book update has outlawed drivers from being able to put their hands by the window net during qualifying.“As determined by NASCAR, once a vehicle exits pit road during a Qualifying attempt, the driver’s hands may not be used to redirect air in any manner, including but not...

item.title: Slawson wins King of the Hammers Race of Kings for a record fourth time
item.description: Randy Slawson prevailed as others hit issues to be crowned King of the Hammers once again, breaking a three-way tie on the all-time wins list.

item.title: Why Formula E’s next boost could come from China
item.description: Chinese automakers are among the biggest in the EV industry but aren't a part of the Formula E grid. Series CEO Jeff Dodds says that could change soon, though.

item.title: Crowdstrike, Kessel teams earn Le Mans invites with Asian Le Mans titles
item.description: The CrowdStrike Racing by APR and Kessel Racing teams earned coveted invitations to enter the 2026 Le Mans 24 Hours in the Asian Le Mans Series season finale in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Cadillac F1 launches 2026 livery with Super Bowl ad
item.description: Cadillac Formula 1 Team revealed the livery for its inaugural campaign in the highest-profile way possible, via a television commercial in the closing stages of Super Bowl LX.
